_note: Front-of-funnel FAQ targeting the most common pre-booking objections for a one-person arborist business in south Ontario. Update with friend's actual answers once we discuss.

items.a: Yes. Tarzan Trimming carries commercial general liability insurance for all tree work. Certificate available on request before any job.
This is owner-led work done outside of regular day-job hours. No overhead from a large crew, no salesperson on commission, no franchise fee structure. The savings get passed to you.

items.q: Do you do emergency tree work?
items.a: For active hazards like a limb on a roof or vehicle, call us and we will tell you how fast we can get there. For genuinely urgent same-day situations during business hours, a commercial crew may be a faster option, and we will tell you who to call if so.

items.q: Will you remove a tree entirely?
items.a: Not yet. Tarzan Trimming focuses on pruning and limb removal right now. Full tree removal will be added as the business grows. If you need a full tree taken down, send a photo and we will point you to a vetted local crew.
All debris is chipped onsite or hauled away at the end of the visit, your call. Final cleanup is included in the quote, no surprise fees.

items.q: How fast can you come quote?
items.a: Most quote visits happen within 3 to 5 business days. Quote visits are free with no obligation.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: E-transfer, cash, or cheque. Payment due on completion of the job, not upfront.

South Ontario from Toronto through the Hamilton and Kitchener corridor. Toronto, Mississauga, Oakville, Burlington, Hamilton, Kitchener, and Whitby are all in the regular service area. Outside that, ask and we will tell you the travel cost honestly.
